01 /

Information you provide

Account records include your name, email and password hash. Verification records may include your legal name, date of birth, country, address, document information, identity uploads and any additional fields requested for your account. Payments include amounts, references and recipient details you submit.

02 /

Activity and security records

EDGE records stakes, accepted odds, results, copy positions, wallet movements, payment requests, promotional redemptions and support conversations. Sessions and server security records can include IP addresses and browser information. These records support account access, settlement, reviews and investigating errors.

03 /

Who can access information

You can view your own account activity. Authorised administrators can review the records needed for account support, payments and identity checks. Hosting and email services process information needed to operate the website and deliver sign-in codes. The built-in support assistant runs within the platform.

04 /

Card payments and external services

When enabled, Stripe Checkout collects card payment details on Stripe’s hosted page. EDGE stores the payment references and status needed to credit your wallet; it does not collect your full card number in its own forms. External services apply their own privacy information.

Stripe privacy information ↗
05 /

Protection and retention

Passwords and email codes are hashed. Pending authentication details, private identity files and support messages are encrypted in storage. Access is restricted by account role. Financial, verification and security records may need to remain available for reviews and transaction history; no automatic deletion period is promised here.

06 /

Questions and account requests

Use account support to ask about your information, report an error or request a correction or deletion. An administrator will review the request, including any records that need to be retained. Do not send identity documents or passwords in the chat.
